legend: The Entomology department at Columbia wants to expand its colony of ants.

The colony currently consists of n$$$n$$$ male and n$$$n$$$ female ants, each numbered 1$$$1$$$ through n$$$n$$$. The scientists want to find a female ant to mate with each male ant. Since ants are polyandrous, one female can mate with multiple males at once.
Two ants can mate only if they are attracted to each other. One male ant may be attracted to multiple female ants, and vice versa.

To find which pairs of ants are attracted to each other, the scientists can run experiments with the aid of an AI (Ant Inspection) tool by Ant-ropic. In one experiment, they take x$$$x$$$ male ants and y$$$y$$$ female ants, and place them in a cell. The AI observes their behaviour and reports one pair of ants which are attracted to each other, or that none exist. The cost of this experiment is x+y$$$x + y$$$ dollars.
More formally, you can make the following queries to the interactor:

"? xi1i2…ixyj1j2…jy$$$x \; i_1 \; i_2 \ldots i_x \; y \; j_1 \; j_2 \; \ldots j_y$$$" — run the experiment on male ants i1,i2,…,ix$$$i_1, i_2, \ldots, i_x$$$ and female ants j1,j2,…,jy$$$j_1, j_2, \ldots, j_y$$$. The interactor replies with some pair of attracted ants "ikjℓ$$$i_k \; j_\ell$$$", meaning that ik$$$i_k$$$-th male ant can mate with jℓ$$$j_\ell$$$-th female ant, or "−1−1$$$-1 \; -1$$$" if no such pair exists. The same pair may be reported in multiple experiments. The cost of this query is x+y$$$x + y$$$ dollars.

After running some experiments, the scientists need to report, for each male ant, which female ant it can mate with, or −1$$$-1$$$ if no such ant exists. Since the scientists are on a budget, the total cost of all experiments may not exceed 35000$$$35 \, 000$$$ dollars.
input: The only line of input contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤400$$$1 \leq n \leq 400$$$) — the size of the male and the female ant colonies.
After you read this line of input, the interaction begins with your first query.
To make a query, output a line (without quotes) in the following format:

"? xi1i2…ixyj1j2…jy$$$x \; i_1 \; i_2 \ldots i_x \; y \; j_1 \; j_2 \; \ldots j_y$$$" (1≤x,y≤n$$$1 \leq x, y \leq n$$$, 1≤i1,i2,…ix≤n$$$1 \leq i_1, i_2, \ldots i_x \leq n$$$, 1≤j1,j2,…jy≤n$$$1 \leq j_1, j_2, \ldots j_y \leq n$$$).

After each query, read two space-separated integers — the answer to the query. If an attracted pair exists, the answer will be "ikjℓ$$$i_k \; j_\ell$$$" for some k$$$k$$$ and ℓ$$$\ell$$$ (1≤k≤x$$$1 \leq k \leq x$$$, 1≤ℓ≤y$$$1 \leq \ell \leq y$$$), indicating the attracted pair. Otherwise, the answer will be "−1−1$$$-1 \; -1$$$".
The cost of this query is x+y$$$x + y$$$.
The total cost of all queries must not exceed 35000$$$35 \, 000$$$.

An answer to the problem is a sequence p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$, where pi$$$p_i$$$ is the index of a female ant with which the i$$$i$$$-th male ant can mate, or −1$$$-1$$$ if no such ant exists.
Once you have determined an answer to the problem, print the line (without quotes) in the following format:
If there are multiple correct answers, output any.
The interactor in this task is not adaptive. In other words, the pairs of attracted ants do not change throughout the interaction.

If you make queries of total cost more than 35000$$$35 \, 000$$$, your program must terminate immediately, and you will receive the Wrong Answer verdict. Otherwise, you can get an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.
After printing each line, do not forget to output the end of line and flush the output buffer. Otherwise, you will receive the Idleness Limit Exceeded verdict. To flush, use:
see the documentation for other languages.
note: In the sample test case, male ant 1$$$1$$$ is attracted to both female ants, and male ant 2$$$2$$$ is attracted to none. In the first query, the AI reveals one of the two attractions. In the second query, no attractions are found. The total cost of these queries is 6$$$6$$$.

legend.ai: 哥伦比亚大学的昆虫学系希望扩大其蚂蚁群体。
目前蚁群由 n$$$n$$$ 只雄蚁和 n$$$n$$$ 只雌蚁组成，每只蚂蚁的编号为 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。科学家希望为每只雄蚁找到一只与之交配的雌蚁。由于蚂蚁实行一妻多夫制，一只雌蚁可以同时与多只雄蚁交配。
两只蚂蚁只有在互相吸引时才能交配。一只雄蚁可能被多只雌蚁吸引，反之亦然。
为了找出相互吸引的蚂蚁对，科学家可以借助 Ant-ropic 提供的 AI(Ant Inspection)工具进行实验。在一次实验中，他们取出 x$$$x$$$ 只雄蚁和 y$$$y$$$ 只雌蚁，并将它们放入一个小室中。AI 会观察它们的行为，并报告一对相互吸引的蚂蚁，或者报告不存在这样的蚂蚁对。该实验的费用为 x+y$$$x + y$$$ 美元。
更形式化地说，你可以向交互器发出以下查询：

"? xi1i2…ixyj1j2…jy$$$x \; i_1 \; i_2 \ldots i_x \; y \; j_1 \; j_2 \; \ldots j_y$$$" — 在雄性蚂蚁 i1,i2,…,ix$$$i_1, i_2, \ldots, i_x$$$ 和雌性蚂蚁 j1,j2,…,jy$$$j_1, j_2, \ldots, j_y$$$ 上进行实验。交互器会回复一对互相吸引的蚂蚁 "ikjℓ$$$i_k \; j_\ell$$$"，表示第 ik$$$i_k$$$ 只雄性蚂蚁可以与第 jℓ$$$j_\ell$$$ 只雌性蚂蚁交配；如果不存在这样的配对，则回复 "−1−1$$$-1 \; -1$$$"。同一配对可能在多次实验中被报告。这次查询的花费为 x+y$$$x + y$$$ 美元。
运行若干次实验后，科学家需要报告每只雄性蚂蚁可以与哪只雌性蚂蚁交配；如果没有这样的雌性蚂蚁，则报告 −1$$$-1$$$。由于科学家的预算有限，所有实验的总花费不能超过 35000$$$35 \, 000$$$ 美元。

input.ai: 输入只有一行，包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤400$$$1 \leq n \leq 400$$$)——雄性蚂蚁和雌性蚂蚁群落的大小。
读入这行输入后，交互从你的第一次查询开始。
要进行一次查询，请按以下格式输出一行（不含引号）：

"? xi1i2…ixyj1j2…jy$$$x \; i_1 \; i_2 \ldots i_x \; y \; j_1 \; j_2 \; \ldots j_y$$$"(1≤x,y≤n$$$1 \leq x, y \leq n$$$，1≤i1,i2,…ix≤n$$$1 \leq i_1, i_2, \ldots i_x \leq n$$$，1≤j1,j2,…jy≤n$$$1 \leq j_1, j_2, \ldots j_y \leq n$$$)。
每次查询后，读入两个由空格分隔的整数，即该查询的答案。如果存在吸引的一对，答案将为 "ikjℓ$$$i_k \; j_\ell$$$"，其中 k$$$k$$$ 和 ℓ$$$\ell$$$ 满足 (1≤k≤x$$$1 \leq k \leq x$$$, 1≤ℓ≤y$$$1 \leq \ell \leq y$$$)，表示这对吸引的配对。否则，答案将为 "−1−1$$$-1 \; -1$$$"。
该查询的费用为 x+y$$$x + y$$$。
问题的答案是一个序列 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$，其中 pi$$$p_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 只雄蚂蚁可以交配的雌蚂蚁的编号；如果不存在这样的雌蚂蚁，则为 −1$$$-1$$$。
确定问题的答案后，请按照以下格式输出一行（不带引号）：
如果有多个正确答案，输出任意一个。
本题中的交互器不是自适应的。换句话说，在整个交互过程中，互相吸引的蚂蚁对不会发生变化。
如果你发出的查询总成本超过 35000$$$35 \, 000$$$，程序必须立即终止，你将收到 Wrong Answer 判定。否则，由于你的程序会继续从已关闭的流中读取，你可能会得到任意判定。
每输出一行后，不要忘记输出行尾并刷新输出缓冲区。否则，你将收到 Idleness Limit Exceeded 判定。要进行刷新，请使用：
C++ 中的 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；
其他语言请参阅相关文档。

note.ai: 在输入样例中，雄蚁 1$$$1$$$ 会被两只雌蚁吸引，而雄蚁 2$$$2$$$ 不会被任何一只雌蚁吸引。在第一次查询中，AI 揭示了两种吸引关系中的一种。在第二次查询中，没有发现任何吸引关系。这些查询的总费用为 6$$$6$$$。
